name: Battle Roar
blurb: Passive:  Rengar stores grey health equal to a portion of damage taken within a brief moment.

effects.description: Passive: Rengar stores 50% of the post-mitigation damage he has taken in the last 1.5 seconds as grey health on his health bar, increased to 100% of damage taken from monsters.
Active: Rengar roars, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and 65 - 137.65 (based on level) bonus magic damage to monsters, and consuming his grey health to heal for the same amount.
Ferocity Bonus: Battle Roar's damage is modified to deal 50 - 240 (based on level) (+ 80% AP) magic damage. Rengar cleanses himself from all crowd control.

notes:
Grey health will not be consumed upon casting Battle Roar despite visually appearing so. It will only ever expire after its duration ends.
The ability will visibly attempt to but fail to buffer if cast during a non-ability cast time. [2] (unexpected)
